Project
Enterprise Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure

Case studies

01 / DataOracle RAC on AWSA 21+ node Oracle RAC cluster running active-active database failover on AWS, built around software-defined clustered storage to work around AWS's lack of native shared-SAN block storage. → 02 / PlatformHybrid object storageA self-hosted distributed object storage layer unifying backups, ERP media, and mail archives across a public cloud, an on-prem data center, and a private OpenStack cloud behind one S3 API. → 03 / ResilienceMail disaster recoveryAn automated EC2 failover system for a single-instance enterprise mail platform, cutting recovery time from 4+ hours of manual recovery to under 3 minutes, paired with tiered S3 backups and DNS-authenticated delivery. →
